name: I2C pull-up (3.3V, 1.8k)
description: I2C bus pull-up pair for 3.3V rail. 1.8k suits Fast-mode (400kHz) with typical bus capacitance; Rp(min)=(VDD-VOL)/IOL=(3.3-0.4)/0.003=967R, Rp(max) set by bus cap per spec.
circuit_source: NXP UM10204 (I2C-bus specification) Rev 7.0, section 7.1 'Pull-up resistor sizing', Fig 42-43 + Eq 1-2. https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/user-guide/UM10204.pdf
